name: Level
fullname: Level: ModAmt, MinMax, Track and Hold, Window
summary: ModAmt, MinMax, Track and Hold, Window.
author: Animatek
about: The G2's ModAmt, MinMax, T&H and WindSw in one module, by a Mode selector. Two inputs, A and B, and two outputs.

ModAmt: B sets how much of A goes through, by Amount. Out 2 is the rest. MinMax: Out 1 is the lower of A and B, Out 2 the higher. T&H: Out 1 tracks A while B is high and holds it while low; Out 2 does the opposite. Window: Out 1 is A while B is between Lo and Hi, else 0; Out 2 is high while it is.
usage: Use ModAmt with Amount at 127 as a VCA for control signals.
Use T&H with a clock at B to sample a signal: a sample-and-hold.
Use Window to open a path only when another signal is in range.
notes: Control rate, for levels and gates.

patch_notes.level.pch: Two LFOs and a clock drive the Level through its modes (ModAmt, MinMax, T&H); Out 1, Out 2, A and B are on the outs.
